description: This is a Java class defining a builder for creating and manipulating DittoHeaders objects, providing a fluent API for construction and initialization.

classes.name: DefaultDittoHeadersBuilder
classes.description: A mutable builder class with a fluent API for creating DittoHeaders.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new DefaultDittoHeadersBuilder with an empty headers map.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new DefaultDittoHeadersBuilder initialized with a given headers map or from a DittoHeaders object.

methods.name: of (JsonObject)
methods.description: Creates a DefaultDittoHeadersBuilder initialized from a JSON object.

methods.name: getEmptyHeaders
methods.description: Returns an immutable empty DittoHeaders instance.

methods.name: doBuild
methods.description: Returns the provided DittoHeaders instance; used internally during build process.
